crossRefs.note: Blessed is the man who always fears; but one who hardens his heart falls into trouble.
He who is often rebuked and stiffens his neck will be destroyed suddenly, with no remedy.
“Lift up your eyes to the bare heights, and see! Where have you not been lain with? You have sat waiting for them by…
Therefore the showers have been withheld and there has been no latter rain; yet you have had a prostitute’s forehead…
O Yahweh, don’t your eyes look on truth? You have stricken them, but they were not grieved. You have consumed them, but…
Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? No, they were not at all ashamed. They couldn’t blush. Therefore…
“As for the word that you have spoken to us in Yahweh’s name, we will not listen to you.
But we will certainly perform every word that has gone out of our mouth, to burn incense to the queen of the sky, and…
The righteousness of the blameless will direct his way, but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.
I considered my ways, and turned my steps to your statutes.
Because he considers, and turns away from all his transgressions that he has committed, he shall surely live. He shall…
Now therefore this is what Yahweh of Armies says: Consider your ways.
This is what Yahweh of Armies says: “Consider your ways.
Now, please consider from this day and backward, before a stone was laid on a stone in Yahweh’s temple.
‘Consider, please, from this day and backward, from the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, since the day that the…
Is the seed yet in the barn? Yes, the vine, the fig tree, the pomegranate, and the olive tree haven’t produced. From…
But when he came to himself he said, ‘How many hired servants of my father’s have bread enough to spare, and I’m dying…
I will get up and go to my father, and will tell him, “Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in your sight.
Now may our God and Father himself, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way to you.

translations.web: A wicked man hardens his face; but as for the upright, he establishes his ways.
translations.bsb: A wicked man hardens his face, but the upright man makes his way sure.
translations.kjv: A wicked man hardeneth his face: but as for the upright, he directeth his way.
translations.asv: A wicked man hardeneth his face; But as for the upright, he establisheth his ways.
